saw_lines: Nobody wants a meter. They buy after a shocking bill or a solar install, then keep it for years.
So the sale is won in the first line, where the bill or solar panel gets named before the scroll.
Your 30 live ads carry no proof number, so collect one review count or orders shipped and lead the next batch with it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 3 Nov 2026
points: None of your 30 live ads shows a proof number, so a new buyer has no reason to trust you over the rest. Collect one number, like review count or orders shipped, and lead the next batch with it.
16 of your 30 live ads are catalog feed ads with no story, so nothing gives the feed a reason to stop. Add three story ads that open on a surprise energy bill and show the P1 meter as the fix.
0 of your 14 copy ads mention an offer, so a first time buyer gets nothing to act on today. Give buyers one reason to order now, a first order offer or a bundle, and open three new ads with it.

Your 14 copy ads open with 8 different stories and the biggest leads only 3 ads, so none gets enough repeats. Keep the two best, solar self use and energy bill savings, and build the next batch from them.
